subject: Kickoff: KwikBucks clustering for platform-scale dedup
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the KwikBucks track. The dedup problem in the data platform is exactly the paper's setting: we have a cheap-weak signal (embedding similarity) for every record pair, and an expensive-strong signal (a cross-encoder judgment) we can only afford on a small budget of pairs. KwikBucks does correlation clustering that spends the strong-query budget where it matters — the core is the qwick_cluster_using_ordering routine in model_utils.py, and the released baselines give us honest comparisons.

Milestones (Mar 2 - Jun 22):
- Apr 3: reproduce paper results on the released datasets
- May 15: dedup prototype on one internal record corpus, budget-vs-quality curve
- Jun 15: readout with a go/no-go on platform integration for Q3

Daniela — staffing and infra ask when you can. The strong-signal service is the piece that needs real engineering.

Dmitri
